landing.headline: Pick your favourite. Give what it's worth. See where it stands.
landing.subheader: Expressions of joy, for charitable causes, in the name of those we love.
landing.how.occasion.label: Pick the occasion
landing.how.occasion.body: A memorial, a celebration or a fundraiser. The occasion sets the register for everything that follows.
landing.how.charity.label: Choose the charity
landing.how.charity.body: Any registered charity, found on the Charity Commission’s register. Every pledge is for it.
landing.how.topic.label: Pick the topic
landing.how.topic.body: Something they love, with a favourite everyone can name. Pick from the catalogue or make your own list.
landing.how.header.label: Set the header
landing.how.header.body: The name, a photo and a line of context, as the page will show them.
landing.how.story.label: Tell the story
landing.how.story.body: A line about the occasion, and the note that is revealed once a guest has pledged.
landing.how.share.label: Share it
landing.how.share.body: A link for the group chat, a QR code for the room, printed stationery for the tables.
landing.how.room.label: Watch it live
landing.how.room.body: Watch standings change as pledges land, on your phone or together on a large screen.
landing.how.keepsake.label: Print a keepsake
landing.how.keepsake.body: After the favpoll closes, print and share a memento of the favpoll, capturing all the detail that made it special.
landing.record.principle: Every pledge makes an eternal mark by feeding the record — all-time rankings for favpoll topics.
memorials.headline: Pick their topic. Poll its favourites. Give to charity in their memory.
memorials.subheader: Help friends and family lend the occasion extra meaning.
memorials.how.title: How it works
memorials.how.pick.label: Pick
memorials.how.pick.body: Guests pick favourites from the chosen topic. If they can’t decide, they are encouraged to give to the shared pot instead.
memorials.how.pledge.label: Pledge
memorials.how.pledge.body: Guests pledge what their favourite is worth and give extra to the shared pot, to help other guests (e.g. children) take part.
memorials.how.reveal.label: Reveal
memorials.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are unlocked, showing where the favourites rank and how much money has been raised for charity.
memorials.pro.title: Celebrant, funeral director, or hospice?
memorials.pro.body: If you help families plan farewells, we'd love to make favpoll useful to you — printed packs, examples to share, and nothing to sell.
memorials.close.headline: In their honour, by their favourites.
memorials.close.cta: Start a memorial favpoll — always free
memorials.artefacts.title: A few ideas
memorials.artefacts.pack.label: QR-coded order of service
memorials.artefacts.pack.body: Include the QR code on the order of service to cater for all guests, including those who may not attend the wake. Also eliminate the need for a collection box.
memorials.artefacts.reveal.label: Personal note
memorials.artefacts.reveal.body: A personal note is especially poignant for a memorial. Like a final word from them or a parting gift. It could be a direct quote, arranged long in advance.
memorials.artefacts.display.label: Quiet live display
memorials.artefacts.display.body: Display the favpoll in tribute mode at the wake. Let guests pledge in their own time and glance at the display rather than reach for their phone.
memorials.artefacts.keepsake.label: Tribute keepsake
memorials.artefacts.keepsake.body: After the favpoll has closed, invite guests to print and frame a tribute style keepsake as a lasting memory of your loved one.
celebrations.headline: Pick their topic. Poll its favourites. Give to charity in their name.
celebrations.subheader: Energise the occasion and turn the fun into something good.
celebrations.how.title: How it works
celebrations.how.pick.label: Pick
celebrations.how.pick.body: Guests pick favourites from the chosen topic. If they can’t decide, they are encouraged to give to the shared pot instead.
celebrations.how.pledge.label: Pledge
celebrations.how.pledge.body: Guests pledge what their favourite is worth and give extra to the shared pot, to help other guests (e.g. children) take part.
celebrations.how.reveal.label: Reveal
celebrations.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are unlocked, showing where the favourites rank and how much money has been raised for charity.
celebrations.artefacts.title: A few ideas
celebrations.artefacts.cards.label: QR-coded place names
celebrations.artefacts.cards.body: Welcome each guest with a QR-coded place name on the table. Make the favpoll a feature of the occasion, inviting discussion between courses.
celebrations.artefacts.reveal.label: Surprise note
celebrations.artefacts.reveal.body: Add meaning to the note and create a talking point by making news of the chosen topic.
celebrations.artefacts.display.label: Live display centrepiece
celebrations.artefacts.display.body: Place the favpoll front and centre. Watch the standings move as pledges land, and let guests chase the goal through the evening.
celebrations.artefacts.keepsake.label: Keepsake
celebrations.artefacts.keepsake.body: After the favpoll has closed, print and send a keepsake to remember the occasion by.
celebrations.close.headline: For their big day, by their favourites.
celebrations.close.cta: Start a celebration favpoll — always free
celebrations.pro.title: Wedding planner, celebrant, or venue?
celebrations.pro.body: If you help people plan celebrations, we'd love to make favpoll useful to you — printed packs, examples to share, and nothing to sell.
fundraisers.headline: Pick a topic. Poll its favourites. Give to charity in support.
fundraisers.subheader: Offer supporters something to play for and a target to chase.
fundraisers.how.title: How it works
fundraisers.how.pick.label: Pick
fundraisers.how.pick.body: Guests pick favourites from the chosen topic. If they can’t decide, they are encouraged to give to the shared pot instead.
fundraisers.how.pledge.label: Pledge
fundraisers.how.pledge.body: Guests pledge what their favourite is worth and give extra to the shared pot, to help other guests (e.g. children) take part.
fundraisers.how.reveal.label: Reveal
fundraisers.how.reveal.body: After pledging, the standings are unlocked, showing where the favourites rank and how much money has been raised for charity.
fundraisers.artefacts.title: A few ideas
fundraisers.artefacts.topic.label: Homemade topic
fundraisers.artefacts.topic.body: Create a topic for your fundraiser that is unique to the event. Give extra meaning to guest interaction.
fundraisers.artefacts.share.label: Shared link
fundraisers.artefacts.share.body: Spread the news of the fundraiser by sharing the link by group chat or email signature, for events where participation is entirely online.
fundraisers.artefacts.reveal.label: Personal note
fundraisers.artefacts.reveal.body: Thank participants for their support and take the opportunity to inspire extra motivation to reach the goal.
fundraisers.artefacts.keepsake.label: Thank-you keepsake
fundraisers.artefacts.keepsake.body: After the favpoll has closed, thank participants again and invite them to share in your achievement by downloading a memento.
fundraisers.close.headline: For your cause, by their favourites.
fundraisers.close.cta: Start a fundraiser favpoll — always free

fundraisers.pro.body: If you run fundraising events, we'd love to make favpoll useful to you — printed packs, examples to share, and nothing to sell.
